tests.title: Case 1 - Verify that all monomers composing a preset are saved as hidden entries in the monomer library
Case 2 - Verify that presets composed only of existing visible monomers do not create additional visible monomer entries
Case 3 - Verify that hidden monomer properties are not checked for uniqueness against visible monomers
Case 4 - Verify that hidden monomer properties are not checked for uniqueness across different presets
Case 5 - Verify that hidden monomer properties are still validated for formatting
Case 6 - Verify that fixing formatting issues allows preset to be saved
Case 7 - Verify that visible monomer creation still enforces uniqueness while hidden monomers do not
Case 8 - Verify that hidden monomers created with a preset are not selectable as components
